description: Directed-gradient trainable anchors = SMART DATA-DRIVEN PAIR SAMPLING. Fork of exp530/534, all 4 LUTs use SoftAnchorPairMHLUT: each anchor pair is TWO learned soft convex blends a=softmax(alpha/tau).x, b=softmax(beta/tau).x compared by sign(a-b). Unlike exp533/534 (argmax-STE: softmax only in backward, hard coord in forward -> UNDIRECTED flips, random walk, bpb tracked flip-count upward), here the softmax is IN the forward so a,b move continuously -> boundary rotates smoothly -> DIRECTED gradient, no re-fit tax. sign(a-b) keeps the explicit PAIR comparison; softmax(alpha)-softmax(beta) is zero-sum so it stays a shift-invariant difference. anchor_tau is ANNEALED 1.0 -> 0.02 (log-linear over first 80%, held last 20%) so each softmax collapses to ~one-hot and the FINAL model makes HARD pair decisions; a separate exact hard-argmax forward (mod.hard=True) is eval'd each step (val_bpb_hard) and is the deployable model. Replaces fixed CANONICAL_FULL_COVERAGE pair sampling with a learned one. Same naps/tphs/optim/steps as exp530. ~130M (anchors 21.8M + weights 93.6M). vs exp530 1.4731 (fixed coverage), exp534 (undirected, ~+0.026), exp513 1.4825.
